name: Flohmarkt am C&C Landau

rhythm.de: Jeden Samstag, nicht an Feiertagen und nicht im Dezember
rhythm.en: Every Saturday, not on public holidays and not in December

facts: under a roof, so it runs in rain and in heat
second-hand, junk, vintage and some new goods
no registration — sellers turn up and take a pitch
the organiser says the choice is widest between 15:00 and 16:30
the organiser calls it one of the steadiest weekly markets in the Pfalz
stall up to 4 m from 20 EUR, pitches handed out from 13:00
notes: Dates derived from the stated weekly rhythm. The organiser states no market on public holidays and none in December, with the last of the season on 28 November 2026 — so 3 October (Tag der Deutschen Einheit, a Saturday) is left out and nothing follows 28 November inside the window. Visitor entry is not stated. Impressum: Rudolf Reis, Messe und Marktorganisation Reis, Spelzenackerstraße 49, 67473 Lindenberg (Pfalz). Same organiser also runs a Sunday market on Landau's new Messegelände (18 October and 8 November 2026) and weekly markets in Bobenheim-Roxheim and Wörth. Coordinates from Nominatim for Johannes-Kopp-Straße 10.

description.de: Jeden Samstag von 15 bis 18 Uhr unter einem Dach, also bei Regen wie bei Hitze. Gebrauchtes, Trödel, Vintage und etwas Neuware; wer verkaufen will, kommt ab 13 Uhr und nimmt einen Platz, ohne Anmeldung. Der Veranstalter sagt, die Auswahl sei zwischen 15 und 16.30 Uhr am größten.
description.en: Every Saturday from 3 to 6 under a roof, so rain or heat makes no difference. Second-hand, junk, vintage and a little new stock; sellers turn up from 1 and take a pitch, no registration. The organiser says the choice is widest between 3 and half past 4.
